title: Break-in at Brown's house: passport taken, ashes moved

tellings.quote: The only thing that was like totally removed from the premise and never recovered was my civilian passport. Uh, my grandfather's ashes were put out in the [sighs and gasps]

plain: Someone broke into the home of Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon employee who has come forward as a whistleblower, and the only thing taken and never recovered was his civilian passport. Brown tells it himself and says his grandfather's ashes had also been moved and put out, and he points to a police record of the break-in.
